Air Force Airman 1st Class Ryan Moran, a civil engineer assigned to the 5th Civil Engineering Squadron, Base Emergency Engineering Force, embarked aboard the amphibious assault ship USS Kearsarge, snaps a chalk line on a sheet of plywood. Kearsarge is the primary platform for the Caribbean phase of the humanitarian/civic assistance mission Continuing Promise 2008, an equal-partnership mission involving the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, Brazil, France, Nicaragua, Panama, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Trinidad and Tobago and Guyana.
